events.name: Bash
events.head: Inspect s1-blog guide and images
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; ls app/src/content/guides/ | head; f=$(grep -rl "s1-blog" app/src/content/guides --include=*.ts | head -3); echo "$f"; grep -n "capture\|shot\|img\|image" $(echo "$f" | grep s1-blog.ts) | head -30; ls -la app/public/guides/s1-blog/ | head -20; git log --oneline -3 -- app/public/guides/s1-blog

events.name: Bash
events.head: Check slot wiring in guide files
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; grep -n "02.webp\|06.webp\|capture\|shot:" app/src/content/guides/s1-traffic/s1-blog.ts | head; grep -n "shot\|capture" app/src/content/guides/s3-nurture/s3-tantra-pro-flow.ts | head -30; ls app/public/guides/s3-tantra-pro-flow/

events.name: Bash
events.head: Check s3 capture slots and scripts
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; grep -c capture_needed app/src/content/guides/s3-nurture/s3-tantra-pro-flow.ts; grep -n "capture_needed" app/src/content/guides/s3-nurture/s3-tantra-pro-flow.ts | cut -c1-200; ls app/public/guides/s3-tantra-pro-flow/ | tr '\n' ' '; ls app/scripts | grep -i "check-guides\|probe-guides"

events.name: Bash
events.head: Look for frontend checkout, run check-guides
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/app; ls -d ~/*tantra* ~/code/* ~/src/* 2>/dev/null | grep -i "frontend\|tantra" | head; timeout 120 node scripts/check-guides.mjs 2>&1 | tail -5; git -C .. show HEAD~0 --stat --oneline f1db2ea | head; git -C .. log origin/main..main --oneline

events.name: Bash
events.head: Run check-guides and find frontend repo
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/app; node scripts/check-guides.mjs 2>&1 | grep -i "capture" | tail -5; find ~ -maxdepth 3 -type d -name "tantra-frontend*" 2>/dev/null | head -3

events.text: Checking the s1-blog captures, then trying the local tantra-frontend-v2 checkout I just found for the three S3 shots.

events.name: Bash
events.head: Inspect tantra-frontend-v2 checkout
events.input: $ cd ~/tantra-frontend-v2; git log --oneline -1; ls; grep -n '"dev"\|"next"\|"vite"' package.json; ls .env* 2>/dev/null; ls node_modules | wc -l; grep -rln "NEXT_PUBLIC_API\|VITE_API\|baseURL" src 2>/dev/null | head -5
